context_for_next_testing_agent: v37 fully verified. Key invariants now enforced: (1) frontend-supplied license_key MUST exist in db.licenses to grant reseller scope; unknown key → owner_license_key='__none__' (sees zero data). (2) /api/admin/whoami returns master_ip/master_host/master_key ONLY when caller is authenticated master (via x-master-key header or gws_master_session cookie or valid XFF=MASTER_IP+MASTER_KEY). (3) bayi cannot delete another tenant's mail_events (db_deleted=0 on cross-tenant mid). Regression tests in /app/backend/tests/test_v37_* + test_v36_* + test_v35_* all pass together.
rca of the issue: Before v37: _tenant_scope trusted frontend license_key blindly if it matched plugin_state.main.license_key — but plugin_state.main was set to the MASTER key on the SaaS host, so every reseller (whose browser sent their own bayi key) fell through to the same plugin_state fallback and got scope={is_master:false, owner_license_key:MASTER_KEY} → same records as master. Fix: validate license_key against db.licenses first; only fall through to plugin_state if the arg was empty. Similarly _is_master returned master_ip/master_host in every response — leaking master coordinates. Fix: gate those fields behind is_master=True and only add master_key when authenticated. Reproduction (verified): GET /api/queue/stats?license_key=<bayi> from anon browser used to return the master's counter; now returns 0 and scope.license_key==<bayi>.
